commands.command: echo '=== dev.db investigation ===' && ls -la dev.db 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && ls -la prisma/dev.db 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && file dev.db 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && echo 'Checking git stash:' && git stash list 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && echo 'Searching for .db files:' && find /Users/jennalang -name 'dev.db' -size +100k 2>/dev/null | head -10 && echo '---' && echo 'SQLite tables in dev.db:' && sqlite3 dev.db '.tables' 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && echo 'Row counts:' && sqlite3 dev.db 'SELECT count(*) FROM Job;' 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && echo 'Time Machine check:' && ls /Volumes/*/Backups.backupdb 2>/dev/null | head -3
commands.description: Investigate dev.db - check file size, contents, stashes, backups, alternate locations
